description: P1.1 security hardening acceptance specifications. All cases are specification-only until executed against named code, providers and infrastructure.

cases.input: Configured IdP issues an access token with a token-controlled JWKS URL.
cases.expected: Reject token-controlled key discovery and fail closed.
cases.must_not: Do not fetch arbitrary token-provided URLs.

cases.input: Access token has wrong issuer, audience, token type, algorithm or expired claims.
cases.expected: Reject token and record a redacted denial receipt.
cases.must_not: Do not accept a syntactically valid but untrusted JWT.

cases.input: AMR contains an unapproved or unmapped method, or auth_time is stale.
cases.expected: Deny sensitive SCIVE operation and require fresh approved assurance.
cases.must_not: Do not treat generic mfa=true or an AMR string as phishing-resistant proof.

cases.input: Delegated capability is signed by an unknown or rotated-out key.
cases.expected: Reject capability after bounded key resolution.
cases.must_not: Do not fall back to process-local shared HMAC.

cases.input: Capability tenant, audience, action, resource, case or job differs from request.
cases.expected: Deny request before data access or state mutation.
cases.must_not: Do not infer missing binding from caller context.

cases.input: Same JTI is replayed or revoked capability is presented.
cases.expected: Reject replay/revoked capability using shared durable state.
cases.must_not: Do not rely on per-process memory for cross-process replay prevention.

cases.input: Unauthenticated caller invokes proposal creation.
cases.expected: Deny before proposal persistence; record security decision.
cases.must_not: Do not exempt propose_change from authorization because it is not apply.

cases.input: Approve, apply, verify, rollback or recover is invoked outside the policy facade.
cases.expected: Reject direct mutation path; require distinct scoped authorization for each transition.
cases.must_not: Do not trust actor-name strings as authority.

cases.input: Proposer attempts to self-approve a high-impact change or executor attempts sole verification.
cases.expected: Deny or require independent authorized actor.
cases.must_not: Do not count role labels supplied by the same untrusted caller as separation.

cases.input: Database metadata is stored with an unavailable encrypted DB engine.
cases.expected: Fail closed and refuse plaintext fallback.
cases.must_not: Do not call blob-only encryption full database encryption.

cases.input: WAL/SHM/temp files are generated during write, checkpoint, crash or restore.
cases.expected: Demonstrate no sensitive plaintext spill or provide encrypted storage boundary.
cases.must_not: Do not assume SQL database encryption covers files without testing.

cases.input: Logs contain sensitive identity, tokens or object metadata.
cases.expected: Redact secrets, encrypt logs at rest, enforce access and retention.
cases.must_not: Do not log bearer tokens or unredacted sensitive payloads.

cases.input: Restore is attempted with rotated, revoked or mismatched tenant keys.
cases.expected: Restore only under approved key policy and validate tenant context.
cases.must_not: Do not restore ciphertext into a different tenant context.

cases.input: Execution host lacks provisioned rootless OCI or gVisor/Kata.
cases.expected: Return BLOCKED/NOT_RUN; do not execute hostile workload.
cases.must_not: Do not treat command generation or a mock as isolated execution.

cases.input: Caller presents unsigned, stale or mismatched host quota receipt.
cases.expected: Reject receipt and refuse success disposition.
cases.must_not: Do not rely on caller-declared quota values.

cases.input: Workload floods stdout/stderr beyond configured limit.
cases.expected: Stop/kill process group when byte limit is reached; retain bounded evidence.
cases.must_not: Do not buffer unbounded output and truncate after process completion.

cases.input: Fork bomb, memory bomb, CPU loop, disk flood or path attack runs in staging.
cases.expected: Contain workload within enforced host controls and clean resources.
cases.must_not: Do not claim test coverage from a mocked executor.

cases.input: Workload attempts to read another tenant's mounts, database, object storage or KMS key.
cases.expected: Deny at independent infrastructure boundary and retain evidence.
cases.must_not: Do not treat directory naming or application filters as sole isolation.

cases.input: External anchor object is overwritten, deleted, reordered, truncated or points to wrong predecessor.
cases.expected: Detect integrity failure by read-back, signature, hash and sequence validation.
cases.must_not: Do not treat local append-only/hash-chain data as external WORM anchoring.

cases.input: Concurrent proposals, key rotation, replay, restore and independent human review occur.
cases.expected: Demonstrate serialization/idempotency and record signed reviewer decision with conflicts disclosed.
cases.must_not: Do not infer production approval from passing unit tests or an unsigned review template.
